entities.name: Silvos
entities.description: A fungal, Thallid-like Elemental born of the Mirari who became a pit-fighter on Dominaria.

entities.name: Mirari
entities.description: The source of the Elemental Silvos's birth.

entities.name: Grand Coliseum of Otaria
entities.description: The arena in Otaria where Silvos fought as a pit-fighter.

entities.name: Dominara
entities.description: The world on which Silvos was active before the Mending; the page spells it Dominara.

events.summary: Silvos, thrust out of his homeland before he was aware, finds purpose in the pits and becomes a notable pit-fighter in the Grand Coliseum of Otaria.
events.quote: he found both in the pits, becoming a notable pit-fighter in the Grand Coliseum of Otaria

relations.note: Silvos was born of the Mirari.
relations.quote: Silvos is an Elemental born of the Mirari
